Package org.cyclops.integratedterminals.client.gui.container.component

Class CraftingPlanGraphLayout<N extends CraftingPlanGraphLayout.INode<N>>

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integratedterminals.client.gui.container.component.CraftingPlanGraphLayout<N>
Type Parameters:
N - The node type.
public class CraftingPlanGraphLayout<N extends CraftingPlanGraphLayout.INode<N>> extends Object
Places the nodes of a tree in columns from left to right, with the root at the graph origin. This class is independent of Minecraft, so it can be unit-tested and ported easily.
